meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude执行Bash命令（如git、cargo、pytest等）时，自动通过rtk代理压缩，节省60-90%的token。无需任何额外指令。
howto.when: 当Claude调用Bash工具执行开发者命令时触发，例如运行git status或cargo build。

say.text: 运行 git status，看看仓库状态。
say.note: 命令会经过rtk压缩，减少token消耗。

say.text: 执行 cargo build 编译项目。
用 kubectl get pods 查看集群。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically routes Bash tool calls through rtk, achieving 60–90% token savings on common dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.) without any additional instructions.
howto.when_en: This triggers when Claude invokes the Bash tool to execute developer commands, such as running git status or cargo build.

say_en.text: Run git status to check the repo.
say_en.note: Command will be compressed via rtk, saving tokens.

say_en.text: Execute cargo build to compile the project.
say_en.note: rtk proxies cargo commands for savings.

say_en.text: Use kubectl get pods to view clusters.
say_en.note: kubectl is also supported by rtk.
